seoTitle: Gama3 Orderak | Easy Group Food Ordering
description: Share one menu, collect everyone's choices, finalize one food order, and split the receipt fairly with Gama3 Orderak.
eyebrow: One link. Everyone orders. No chat chaos.
heading: The easiest way to collect a group food order
introduction: Create a shared menu, invite friends or coworkers, let each person choose, then finalize one clear order with totals everyone can verify.

sections.heading: Create or reuse a menu
paragraphs: Add restaurant items once, including prices and optional delivery, service, and tax rules. Reuse the menu for the next order.

sections.heading: Invite people and collect choices
paragraphs: Share the order with friends, a saved group, or guests. Everyone records their own quantities while the organizer sees one live total.

sections.heading: Finalize once and split fairly
paragraphs: Lock the final quantities, place one order, and produce a transparent receipt by person or item without manual calculations.

faq.question: Is Gama3 Orderak free to use?
faq.answer: Yes. Creating menus, sharing them, running order rounds, and splitting receipts are all free. You order from the restaurant yourself; the app organises the group, it does not take payment.

faq.question: Do the people I order with need to install anything?
faq.answer: No. It runs in a browser on any phone or computer, and can be installed as an app if you prefer. Everyone needs an account, which takes an email address and a password.

faq.question: How does it decide who owes what?
faq.answer: Each person’s items are priced from the shared menu, then VAT and service are applied and delivery is split either equally or in proportion to what each person ordered — whichever the menu is set to.

faq.question: Can I use it in Arabic?
faq.answer: Yes, in thirteen languages including Arabic and Egyptian Arabic written in Latin script. Right-to-left layouts are supported throughout, and you can change language at any time.
